summary: Implemented `in` membership for Namespace and ClosedNamespace in rdflib/namespace.py, and added tests in test/test_namespace.py. Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ checks node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs; _RDFNamespace inherits it. The IPython completion hook now returns dir(self.uri). New tests cover Namespace prefix (positive, proper-prefix negative, self), SH, RDFS closed (defined, undefined, plain string, Literal), and RDF closed (defined, `_1` container property). Tests were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed.
